label: Mapping code to the four layers
section: Mapping code to the four layers
subgoals: Put legality and the numerical kernel in the core
Put selectable heuristics behind policy interfaces
Put weights in configuration and live state behind hooks

label: Narrow interfaces at the seams
subgoals: Define each seam as an abstract base plus a factory
Pass only the context the plug-in needs as plain data
Keep the hot kernel in the core and call plug-ins in batches

label: Placing a change request
subgoals: Classify a request as value, new behavior at a seam, or invariant change
Route value changes to parameters and new behavior to a plug-in
Escalate invariant changes to a reviewed core edit
